items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff is not afraid of losing Kimi Antonelli to Ferrari
items.summaryEn: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff said he is "0.0%" afraid that Kimi Antonelli could one day switch to Ferrari, calling Antonelli and his family loyal people.
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫不担心失去基米·安东内利转投法拉利
托托·沃尔夫谈到基米·安东内利在其祖国意大利的地位，并解释了他为何不担心这位意大利车手在不久的将来转投法拉利
刘易斯·汉密尔顿、法拉利、安德烈亚·基米·安东内利、梅赛德斯
梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫“0.0%”不担心基米·安东内利可能在F1中转投法拉利。
许多意大利人希望有朝一日能看到这位新科世界冠军坐进红色座舱，但据沃尔夫所说，这在可预见的未来不会发生。
“因为基米和他的家人都是忠诚的人，”沃尔夫向《图片报》解释道，并明确表示他“确信”安东内利不会突然背弃梅赛德斯。“但我们并非只依赖忠诚。
“本赛季已经表明，我们能够赢得比赛和冠军。这对任何车手来说都是最重要的。对基米也是如此。他属于梅赛德斯，就像车轮属于汽车一样。这就是为什么在赢得冠军后，他说他无法想象为梅赛德斯以外的任何车队效力。”
梅赛德斯自安东内利卡丁车时期起就一直支持他，陪伴他走过每一个青训系列赛并进入F1——以及在今年夺得冠军。据沃尔夫所说，这在安东内利与梅赛德斯之间，以及与他个人之间，建立了紧密的纽带。
“两三年前，他每次来布拉克利工厂时都住在我们家。他当时还是未成年人，所以我们不能随便把他安排到酒店。正因如此，他几乎成了我和[妻子]苏茜家里的常客，”这位奥地利人透露。
“晚上我们经常一起看电影——不过实际上只有我一个人在看，因为苏茜看一部电影撑不过10分钟就会睡着，而基米在那些高强度的日子过后已经筋疲力尽。然后他们俩就肩并肩睡着了，我一个人把电影看完。”
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
比迈克尔·舒马赫更受欢迎？
沃尔夫表示，安东内利不为法拉利效力这一事实，并不会削弱他在祖国的人气。这位奥地利人认为，这位出生于博洛尼亚的车手在意大利“绝对”比迈克尔·舒马赫在法拉利时期更受欢迎。
“毕竟他是意大利人，”沃尔夫说，并补充道：“基米凭借他天生的举止和成功所取得的成就是，意大利仍然自然而然地支持自己的国家队法拉利，但也向这个小小的意大利人敞开了心扉和灵魂。”
“铁杆车迷（Tifosi）现在穿着法拉利衬衫，戴着梅赛德斯帽子。蒙扎就是完美的例子。观众们实际上对两辆红色赛车都没有获得第一名感到难过，但他们很高兴他们自己人之一，基米，站在了领奖台的最高处。”
如果沃尔夫如愿以偿，意大利人将需要他们的梅赛德斯帽子很多年。
detailEn: Toto Wolff is not afraid of losing Kimi Antonelli to Ferrari
Toto Wolff discusses Kimi Antonelli’s status in his home country and explains why he is not afraid that the Italian could move to Ferrari in the near future
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff is “0.0%” afraid that Kimi Antonelli could switch to Ferrari in Formula 1.
Many Italians would love to see the new world champion in a red cockpit one day, but according to Wolff, that will not happen in the foreseeable future.

“Because Kimi and his family are loyal people,” Wolff explained to Bild, making clear that he is “convinced” Antonelli will not suddenly turn his back on Mercedes. “But we are not relying solely on loyalty.

“This season has shown that we can win races and titles. That is the most important thing for any driver. For Kimi too. He belongs at Mercedes like wheels belong on a car. That is why, after winning the title, he said that he cannot imagine driving for any team other than Mercedes.”

Mercedes has supported Antonelli since his karting days and accompanied him through every junior series and into F1 – and, this year, to the title. According to Wolff, this has created a close bond between Antonelli and Mercedes, as well as with him personally.

“Two or three years ago, he always stayed at our home when he was at the factory in Brackley. He was still a minor, so we could not simply put him in a hotel. That is why he was practically a permanent guest at [wife] Susie’s and my place,” the Austrian revealed.

“In the evenings, we often watched films together – although it was really only me, because Susie cannot stay awake through a film for more than 10 minutes and Kimi was completely exhausted after the intense days. Then the two of them fell asleep shoulder to shoulder, and I watched the film on my own.”
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
More popular than Michael Schumacher?

According to Wolff, the fact that Antonelli does not drive for Ferrari does not diminish his popularity in his home country. The Austrian believes the Bologna-born racer is “definitely” more popular there than Michael Schumacher was during his Ferrari years.

“He is Italian, after all,” Wolff said, adding: “What Kimi has achieved through his natural demeanour and success is that Italy still naturally roots for its national team, Ferrari, but has also opened its heart and soul to this little Italian.

“The Tifosi now wear Ferrari shirts with Mercedes caps. Monza was the perfect example. The spectators were actually sad that neither of the red cars finished first, but they were happy that one of their own, Kimi, stood at the very top of the podium.”
And if Wolff has his way, Italians will need their Mercedes caps for many more years.

items.originalTitle: Alonso to contest 2027 Dakar Rally with new Aston Martin project
items.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso will contest the Dakar Rally with Aston Martin ahead of the start of the 2027 Formula 1 season, returning to the event after finishing 13th with Toyota in 2020.
detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索将在2027年F1赛季开始前代表阿斯顿·马丁参加达喀尔拉力赛。
阿隆索曾在2020年离开F1期间参加这项传奇的沙漠马拉松赛事，代表丰田获得第13名。
他长期以来公开表示自己很想再次挑战达喀尔，但就在上个月他还淡化了即将回归的说法，称“很难安排，尤其是在同一年兼顾F1和达喀尔这两项挑战”。
但他现在已决定，在同一赛季同时参加这两项赛事正是他想迎接的挑战，并表示这一决定在他确认2027年继续留在阿斯顿·马丁征战F1后变得明确。两年前与阿斯顿·马丁达成上一份合同时，他就曾把达喀尔列为F1之外的重要目标。
阿隆索表示：“最终，这个决定变得很简单。”
“我想完全拥抱这项挑战，在同一年同时征战一级方程式和达喀尔拉力赛。”
“2020年，达喀尔是我职业生涯中最具挑战性也最令人愉快的经历之一。我对这项赛事以及精通它的专家们怀有极大的敬意。”
由于中东持续的安全局势，明年的达喀尔拉力赛已从原计划的沙特阿拉伯路线改至葡萄牙和摩洛哥。
比赛于1月9日至23日举行，比2月24日至27日的一级方程式季前测试早一个月。
阿隆索的队友将是九届世界拉力锦标赛冠军、如今常驻达喀尔领奖台的塞巴斯蒂安·勒布，以及现任世界拉力突袭锦标赛冠军卢卡斯·莫赖斯。
五届达喀尔摩托车组冠军马克·科马将担任阿隆索的领航员，正如他们在2020年的尝试中一样。
阿斯顿·马丁的达喀尔项目将使用“无畏”品牌，该品牌迄今仅以数字形式存在，是为游戏《使命召唤：现代战争4》创作的军用概念车。
它将由传奇的Prodrive团队运营，该团队今年与之前的合作伙伴Dacia一起赢得了达喀尔拉力赛。
阿隆索在2010年代末期在F1之外的冒险包括三次印第安纳波利斯500大赛的尝试——结果从争夺胜利到未能获得参赛资格不等——两次勒芒24小时耐力赛胜利、一个世界耐力锦标赛冠军和一次戴通纳24小时耐力赛胜利。
他最近表示，达喀尔是所有这些中最艰难的任务，因为它与F1所需的技能和风格如此不同。
“对我来说，对一名F1车手来说，这是最困难的挑战，”阿隆索上个月说，“因为在驾驶技术和如何解读地形方面，以及用双脚驾驶赛车的方式——始终同时踩刹车和油门以稳定赛车——它与F1的差异不可能更大了。”
“这与F1完全相反，所以这正是它吸引人的地方。”
阿隆索首次尝试达喀尔的表现如何
阿隆索在2020年首次尝试达喀尔时整体上颇具竞争力。
他受益于一套强大的装备——由Gazoo车队准备的丰田Hilux，该车曾与纳赛尔·阿提亚和吉尼尔·德·维利尔斯一起长期位居前列，达喀尔摩托车传奇科马则担任领航员——最终他以第13名完赛，落后冠军4小时43分钟。
其中仅一小时多一点的损失可以追溯到两个赛段，他在那里因撞上岩石受损和翻车而被迫停车维修。
除此之外，他始终稳定地处于前列附近，在一半的赛段中跻身前七——其中亮点是在第八赛段借助赛道位置优势获得第二名。
阿提亚后来表示，阿隆索的即时速度非常突出，但他可能需要积累更多达喀尔经验，才能考虑尝试夺冠。
“他非常非常有天赋，”阿提亚在2022年说道。
“而他在达喀尔首次做到的是——他展现出了速度。对于这类比赛，你真的需要经验。
“因为，如果你看看达喀尔的历史，你需要有大约四、五、六年的经验，然后才能获胜。”
detailEn: Fernando Alonso will contest the Dakar Rally with Aston Martin ahead of the 2027 Formula 1 season starting.
Alonso competed on the legendary desert marathon in 2020 while on his break from F1, finishing 13th with Toyota.

He has long openly admitted that he would love to tackle the Dakar again, though as recently as last month he played down talk of an imminent return, saying it would be "difficult to fit, especially in the same year, both challenges - Formula 1 and Dakar".

But he has now decided that competing in both in the same season is exactly the challenge he wants to take on, saying that was a decision that crystallised once he'd committed to staying in F1 with Aston Martin for 2027. He had highlighted Dakar as a key non-F1 goal when agreeing his previous deal with Aston Martin two years ago.
"In the end, the decision became simple," said Alonso.
"I wanted to embrace the challenge completely and take on both Formula 1 and the Dakar Rally in the same year.
"In 2020, Dakar was one of the most challenging and enjoyable experiences of my career. I have enormous respect for this race and the specialists who have mastered it."
Next year's Dakar has moved from its planned Saudi Arabian route to Portugal and Morocco due to the ongoing security situation in the Middle East.
It takes place from January 9-23, a month before F1 pre-season testing on February 24-27.
Alonso's team-mates will be nine-time World Rally champion turned regular Dakar podium finisher Sebastien Loeb and reigning World Rally Raid champion Lucas Moraes.
Marc Coma, a five-time Dakar winner in the motorcycle class, will be Alonso's co-driver just as he was for their 2020 attempt.
Aston Martin's Dakar project will use the Dreadnought brand that has so far only existed in digital form, created as a military concept vehicle for the game Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.
It will be run by the legendary Prodrive operation that won this year's Dakar with its previous partner Dacia.

Alonso's adventures outside F1 in the late-2010s included three Indianapolis 500 attempts - in which the outcomes ranged from fighting for victory to failing to quality - two Le Mans 24 Hours victories, a World Endurance Championship title and a Daytona 24 Hours win.
He recently said Dakar had been the hardest mission of them all because it is so different to the skillset and style required for F1.

"That's the most difficult challenge for me, for a Formula 1 driver," Alonso said last month, "because it cannot be more different than F1 in terms of driving techniques and how to read the terrain, and the way you drive the car also with both feet - on brake and throttle all the time to stabilise the car.
"It's completely the opposite of F1, so that's why it's appealing."
How Alonso fared in his first Dakar attempt
Alonso was broadly competitive when trying out the Dakar for the first time in 2020.

He benefitted from a strong package - a Toyota Hilux prepared by the Gazoo team that had been a perennial frontrunner with Nasser Al-Attiyah and Giniel de Villiers, with Dakar bikes legend Coma stepping in as co-driver - and ultimately reached the finish in 13th, 4h43m down on the winner.
Just over an hour of that time loss could be tracked to a pair of stages in which he was halted by repairs for a damaging rock impact and a roll.
He was otherwise reliably there or thereabouts, a top-seven finisher on half the stages - with the highlight a track position-aided second place on stage eight.
Al-Attiyah later said that Alonso's immediate speed had stood out, but that he might need a lot more Dakar experience before he could think about trying to win it.
"He's very, very talented," said Al-Attiyah in 2022.
"And what he did for the first time in the Dakar - he showed the speed. For this kind of race you need to really have experience.
"Because, if you see the history of Dakar, you need to have like four, five, six years' experience, and then you win."

items.originalTitle: Fernando Alonso to return to Dakar Rally with Aston Martin in 2027
items.summaryEn: Two-time Formula 1 world champion Fernando Alonso has been confirmed to race for Aston Martin's factory team in the 2027 Dakar Rally, joining Sebastien Loeb and Lucas Moraes in the line-up. He will drive a Prodrive-built Aston Martin Dreadnought in the 49th edition of the Dakar.
detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索将于2027年代表阿斯顿·马丁重返达喀尔拉力赛。
经过数月猜测，现已确认阿隆索将于明年参加达喀尔，作为Prodrive运营的阿斯顿·马丁车队的一员。
两届F1世界冠军费尔南多·阿隆索将作为阿斯顿·马丁厂队参加2027年达喀尔拉力赛的核心人物，与塞巴斯蒂安·勒布和卢卡斯·莫赖斯一同组成星光熠熠的阵容。
阿隆索将驾驶Prodrive打造的阿斯顿·马丁Dreadnought出战第49届达喀尔拉力赛。该赛事在从原定举办地沙特阿拉伯迁出后，将于2027年1月9日至23日在葡萄牙和摩洛哥举行。
这将标志着这位西班牙人自2020年随丰田完成令人印象深刻的达喀尔首秀以来，首次重返这项全球最受欢迎的拉力越野赛事，当时他获得总成绩第13名，并在第8赛段取得第二名。
这位45岁的车手将再次与马克·科马搭档，后者曾五次获得达喀尔摩托车组冠军，将在这为期两周的马拉松赛事中担任他的领航员。
阿隆索表示：“在决定继续代表阿斯顿·马丁征战一级方程式后，我仔细考虑了达喀尔的事。最终，决定变得很简单。我想全身心迎接挑战，在同一年同时参加一级方程式和达喀尔拉力赛。”
“2020年，达喀尔是我职业生涯中最具挑战性也最令人愉快的经历之一。我对这项赛事以及那些精通它的专家们怀有极大的敬意。
“马克再次与我并肩作战非常重要，而与阿斯顿·马丁、Prodrive、塞巴斯蒂安和卢卡斯一起，我们拥有一支非凡的车队。”
“一级方程式仍然是我的优先事项。但我是一名赛车手，正是这样的挑战让我热爱竞争。我期待看到我们能取得怎样的成就。”
#310 丰田Gazoo Racing车队：费尔南多·阿隆索
阿隆索长期以来一直怀有重返达喀尔的愿望，即便他仍将主要精力放在留在F1上。在他于9月与阿斯顿·马丁续约后，关于他参加2027年赛事的猜测愈演愈烈。
据了解，这位西班牙人还于10月在摩洛哥测试了一辆原型车，此前这个非洲国家被确认为2027年达喀尔拉力赛的主要主办地。拉力赛车手经常在摩洛哥进行测试，为即将到来的赛季做准备，那里广袤的沙漠是达喀尔拉力赛的理想测试场地。
阿隆索参加达喀尔拉力赛的消息于周二得到确认，阿斯顿·马丁宣布将作为厂队历史上首次参加这项世界上最受欢迎的拉力赛。
这家英国制造商将与赛车运动巨头Prodrive一起争夺总冠军荣誉，延续双方已经涵盖GT赛车和此前原型车项目的成功合作关系。
阿斯顿·马丁将参赛的赛车被命名为无畏舰，该车最初是为热门《使命召唤》游戏系列构思的一款纯数字军用车辆。
据了解，Dreadnought 是此前以 Dacia Sandrider 名义参赛的原型车的最新迭代版本，直到雷诺集团在今年与纳赛尔·阿提亚一起赢得胜利后退出越野拉力赛。
Prodrive 也曾运营达契亚的厂商项目，它在夏天与多家制造商就接管 Sandrider 项目进行了讨论，之后与阿斯顿·马丁达成了协议。
阿斯顿·马丁首席执行官阿德里安·霍尔马克表示：“阿斯顿·马丁 Dreadnought 的构想是在最极端的环境下主宰任何地形，并经受住一切考验以完成其使命。”
“现在，我们将与我们的工程合作伙伴 Prodrive 一起，在全球赛车运动中最极端的竞争环境——2027 年达喀尔拉力赛中——挑战这一愿景。”
“开拓先锋理念是阿斯顿·马丁的本性，正如我们一贯所做的那样，在全球舞台上探索它们的极限。”
“我们不回避这样的挑战，而是拥抱它们，有了费尔南多、塞巴斯蒂安和卢卡斯，我们拥有三位伟大的冠军，可以与之一同向2027年达喀尔发起强有力的挑战。”
#219 达契亚 Sandriders 达契亚：塞巴斯蒂安·勒布
阿斯顿·马丁还将倚重九届世界拉力锦标赛冠军勒布的经验，他自2021年起便加入Prodrive的体系，先是Bahrain Raid Xtreme，随后是达契亚。
在与包括福特和丰田在内的多家制造商进行洽谈后，这位法国人将代表阿斯顿·马丁参加他的第11次达喀尔拉力赛，继续追逐他的首个冠军。
“赢得达喀尔对我来说非常重要，”勒布说道。“我们曾多次接近胜利，而继续努力直到实现目标的动力一直都在。与阿斯顿·马丁和Dreadnought一起迎接这一挑战是一个绝佳的机会。这是一个拥有特殊赛车运动故事的品牌，若能帮助它首次赢得达喀尔，我会感到非常自豪。
“这场比赛已多次证明，它需要的远不止速度。你必须应对艰难的日子，照顾好赛车，并保持专注直到终点。有法比安在我身边，还有费尔南多和卢卡斯，我们将把所有的经验带到团队的项目准备和开发中。面对一辆新车有很多东西要学，而我很享受与工程师们一起做这项工作。目标是到达起点时已准备好为胜利而战。”
阿斯顿的达喀尔阵容将由莫赖斯补全，他曾在2025年随丰田赢得世界拉力-越野锦标赛冠军，之后于今年转投达契亚。
在雷诺集团退出后，勒布和莫赖斯都留在Prodrive，而阿提亚和克里斯蒂娜·古铁雷斯成为仅有的两位在2027年尚无席位的达契亚车手。前者如今是史上最成功的拉力赛车手之一，拥有六次达喀尔冠军，但尚未宣布下赛季的计划。
detailEn: Fernando Alonso to return to Dakar Rally with Aston Martin in 2027
Following months of speculation, it has been confirmed that Alonso will race in the Dakar next year as part of the Prodrive-run Aston Martin squad
Two-time Formula 1 champion Fernando Alonso will headline Aston Martin’s factory entry into the Dakar Rally in 2027, joining Sebastien Loeb and Lucas Moraes as part of a star-studded line-up.

Alonso will drive a Prodrive-built Aston Martin Dreadnought in the 49th edition of Dakar, which will take place in Portugal and Morocco from 9-23 January 2027 after being relocated from its original location in Saudi Arabia.

This will mark the Spaniard’s first appearance in the world’s most popular rally-raid since his impressive debut with Toyota in 2020, when he finished 13th overall and recorded a second-place finish on Stage 8.
The 45-year-old will reprise his partnership with Marc Coma, a five-time Dakar winner on motorcycles, who will serve as his navigator for the two-week marathon.

“After deciding to continue racing in Formula 1 with Aston Martin, I thought carefully about Dakar,” said Alonso. “In the end, the decision became simple. I wanted to embrace the challenge completely and take on both Formula 1 and the Dakar Rally in the same year.
“In 2020, Dakar was one of the most challenging and enjoyable experiences of my career. I have enormous respect for this race and the specialists who have mastered it.
“Having Marc alongside me again is very important, and with Aston Martin, Prodrive, Sebastien and Lucas we have an exceptional team.
“Formula 1 remains my priority. But I am a racing driver, and challenges like this are why I love competing. I’m looking forward to seeing what we can achieve.”
#310 Toyota Gazoo Racing: Fernando Alonso

Alonso had long harboured aspirations of returning to the Dakar, even as he continued to put his primary focus on remaining in F1. Speculation about a 2027 entry intensified after he extended his contract with Aston Martin in September.

The Spaniard is also understood to have tested a prototype version of the car in Morocco in October, before the African nation was confirmed as the primary host for the 2027 Dakar. Rally drivers regularly test in Morocco to prepare for the forthcoming season, with its vast deserts serving as an ideal testing ground for the Dakar.
Alonso’s participation in the Dakar was confirmed on Tuesday, as Aston Martin announced that it will be entering the world’s most popular rally-raid as a factory team for the first time in history.
The British manufacturer will compete for outright honours with motorsport powerhouse Prodrive, extending a successful partnership that already encompasses GT racing and previous prototype ventures.
The car that Aston Martin will enter has been badged as Dreadnought, which was first conceived as a digital-only military vehicle for the popular Call of Duty game series.

Dreadnought is understood to be the latest iteration of the prototype that previously competed as the Dacia Sandrider until the Renault Group pulled out of cross-country rallying following its victory with Nasser Al-Attiyah this year.

Prodrive, which also ran the factory Dacia programme, held discussions with multiple manufacturers about taking over the Sandrider project in the summer before reaching an agreement with Aston Martin.
“Aston Martin Dreadnought was conceived to dominate any terrain, under the most extreme circumstances, and come through it all to deliver on its mission,” said Aston Martin CEO Adrian Hallmark.
“Now along with our engineering partner, Prodrive, we will challenge this vision in the most extreme competitive environment in global motorsport – the Dakar 2027.
“It is in Aston Martin’s nature to forge forward with pioneering concepts, and just as we have always done, explore their limits on the global stage.
“We do not shy away from such challenges, but embrace them, and in Fernando, Sebastien and Lucas we have three great champions with whom to mount a formidable challenge on Dakar 2027.”
#219 The Dacia Sandriders Dacia: Sebastien Loeb
Aston Martin will also count on the experience of nine-time World Rally champion Loeb, who has been part of Prodrive’s set-up since 2021, first as Bahrain Raid Xtreme and subsequently Dacia.
After holding talks with several manufacturers, including Ford and Toyota, the Frenchman will contest his 11th Dakar with Aston Martin as he continues his pursuit of a maiden win.

“Winning the Dakar is very important to me,” said Loeb. “We have come close several times, and the motivation is there to keep working until we achieve it. To take on this challenge with Aston Martin and Dreadnought is a great opportunity. It is a brand with a special motorsport story, and I would feel very proud to help it win the Dakar for the first time.

“This race has proved many times that it demands much more than speed. You have to manage the difficult days, look after the car and stay focused until the finish. With Fabian alongside me, and with Fernando and Lucas, we will bring all our experience to the preparation and development of the programme as a team. There is a lot to learn with a new car, and I enjoy that work with the engineers. The objective is to arrive at the start ready to fight for victory.”
Aston’s Dakar line-up will be completed by Moraes, who won the 2025 World Rally-Raid Championship with Toyota before moving to Dacia this year.

With both Loeb and Moraes remaining with Prodrive following Renault Group’s exit, Al-Attiyah and Cristina Gutierrez remain the only Dacia drivers left without a seat for 2027. The former, now one of the most successful rally drivers of all time with six Dakar wins, has yet to announce his plans for next season.

detailEn: Williams, Aston Martin among new F1 liveries for Las Vegas GP as Acura "replaces" Honda
Formula 1 teams are rolling out one-off liveries for Formula 1's Las Vegas Grand Prix, with Aston Martin promoting Honda's performance brand Acura
Williams and Aston Martin are among the F1 teams to have revamped their car liveries for this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix.
F1 heads to Las Vegas for its third of three US races, with the entertainment capital having quickly become one of the series' key commercial weekends for teams and their partners.
As a result, several teams are rolling out bespoke liveries this week, with Williams deploying a blue chrome livery on the FW48 races by Alex Albon and Carlos Sainz.
Meanwhile, Aston Martin is replaces all of its main logos of power unit partner Honda with those of Acura, Honda's luxury brand which is primarily active in North America.
Acura will adorn the nose, engine cover and driver race suits of the AMR-26 as part of a long line of US takeovers for Honda's F1 teams.
Fernando Alonso's and Lance Stroll's cars will also receive additional notes of white on the nose, sidepod and engine cover at the behest of sponsor CoreWeave.
The Alpine team will meanwhile feature additional pink branding on the sidepod for outgoing title sponsor BWT.

22岁的车手将从MP Motorsport转会至F2，这是他第三个赛季参加F2，此前他已经在本年度获得了两次领奖台的成绩。

戈特海姆曾是红牛青训项目的成员两年，于2025年底离开。在晋升至F2之前，他在2022年赢得了11场胜利，获得了欧罗巴公式开放赛冠军，并在FIA F3中赢得了两场比赛。
在宣布这笔交易时，LN4 Fusion首席执行官丹·理查兹表示，德国车手的经验使他成为车队第一个赛季的最佳选择。
"奥利弗是我们队的绝佳选择。他对赛车、赛道和锦标赛都非常了解，他今年的领奖台表现也显示他已经采取了必要的步骤来争夺领奖台，”理查兹说。
"我们希望为他提供他所需要的环境和支持，以继续朝着他的最终目标迈进，并且我们相信，我们一起可以有一个强劲的赛季，”戈特说。
戈特表示，他认为2027年可能是他争夺冠军的最佳机会。
"我非常激动能够加入LN4 Fusion车队参加2027赛季！这是一个非常激动人心的项目，我迫不及待地想要成为其中的一员。我真心觉得明年可能会是我的年份，我决心充分利用这次机会，”他说。
“作为德国赛车运动团队与奥迪合作的一部分，我已经在奥迪的F1模拟器中完成了几节练习，这让我在即将到来的赛季之前获得了有用的经验和赛道洞察。”
LN4 Fusion的欧洲运营将由Prema车队的前成员领导，前Prema老板Rene Rosin担任顾问和车队负责人，前Prema技术总监Guillaume Capietto担任赛车总监。
detailEn: Lando Norris's LN4 Fusion signs former Red Bull junior Oliver Goethe as its first F2 driver
Goethe will join from MP Motorsport for his third F2 season after two podiums this year
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Lando Norris's new junior team LN4 Fusion has signed former Red Bull junior Oliver Goethe as its first driver for the 2027 Formula 2 season.
The 22-year-old will make the move from MP Motorsport for his third season in F2, after celebrating two podium finishes so far this year.

LN4 Fusion was granted an entry to F2 last month, as the only new team for the championship's next three-year cycle. The McLaren Formula 1 driver launched the team in September, and it will also run cars in Formula 3, Italian Formula 4 and British F4.

Goethe was part of Red Bull's junior programme for two years before leaving at the end of 2025. Before stepping up to F2, he won the Euroformula Open title in 2022 with 11 victories, and took two wins in FIA Formula 3.
Announcing the deal, LN4 Fusion chief executive Dan Richards said the German's experience made him the right choice for the team's first season.

"Oliver is a great choice for our team. He knows the car, the tracks and the championship well, and his podiums this year show that he has taken the steps needed to fight at the front," Richards said.
"We want to give him the environment and support he needs to continue making progress towards his ultimate goal, and we are confident that together we can have a strong season."
Goethe said he believes 2027 could be his best chance yet to fight for the title.

"I'm absolutely thrilled to be joining LN4 Fusion for the 2027 season! It's a really exciting project, and I can't wait to be part of it. I genuinely feel that next year could be my year, and I'm determined to make the most of this opportunity," he said.

"As part of the cooperation between Motorsport Team Germany and Audi, I have already completed several sessions in Audi's F1 simulator, gaining useful experience and insight into the tracks ahead of the upcoming season."

LN4 Fusion's European operation will be led by former members of the Prema team, with ex-Prema boss Rene Rosin on board as a consultant and team principal, and former Prema technical chief Guillaume Capietto as racing director.

detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯：F1需要更好的雨胎，拉斯维加斯雨战会“很吓人”
领先的F1车手们希望倍耐力能对其湿地轮胎系列做出重大改进
世界冠军兰多·诺里斯希望F1轮胎供应商倍耐力在2027年推出大幅改进的雨胎，因为他预计现有雨胎在拉斯维加斯这类低下压力赛道上无法正常工作。
在马来西亚和新加坡经历部分受雨水影响的比赛周末后，F1的2026款赛车在巴西大奖赛首次经历真正意义上的湿地排位赛和正赛，倍耐力的全雨胎和半雨胎配方都在圣保罗接受了测试。排位赛因多个弯道积水而中断超过一小时，打滑（aquaplaning）风险促使车手在Q1使用全雨胎，随后换上半雨胎。
这场比赛在湿地胎下开始并结束，中间有一段干燥期，消除了此前对2026代赛车在湿滑条件下表现的担忧。但尽管巴西站呈现了一场精彩的表演，倍耐力的雨胎在正确的工作窗口内基本按预期工作，车手们仍然认为今年的硬质湿地胎需要在低温性能上改进，因为他们在 赛段开始时和前往发车格的圈中难以将赛车保持在赛道上。
由于英特拉格斯是赛历上最容易让轮胎进入工作范围的赛道之一，几位车手担心倍耐力的产品在并非如此的赛道上不够稳健，比如即将到来的拉斯维加斯街道赛道。
国际汽联的官方天气预报尚未公布，但其他预测显示周四晚间第一节自由练习的降雨概率超过50%，之后条件更可能干燥。
由于拉斯维加斯周末气温远低于10摄氏度，且赛道缺乏任何高速弯道来给轮胎施加横向负荷，迈凯伦车手诺里斯表示湿地练习会相当“可怕”，因为湿地胎在太冷时无法工作。
当被 Motorsport.com 问及对本规则周期首个真正湿地周末的评判时，诺里斯说：“轮胎变冷时，情况相当糟糕。在前往发车格的圈里，当它们变得非常冷时，感觉糟透了。如果进入合适的工作窗口，它们就很好。所以，我认为可怕的时刻是如果你去拉斯维加斯却无法让轮胎升温。你需要比我们这里好得多的轮胎，因为那会非常糟糕。”
巴西站亚军马克斯·维斯塔潘补充道：“我认为主要是工作范围有点太小了。热的时候还可以，但冷的时候，它们真的像石头一样。这是我们需要努力解决的问题，要在全雨胎（extreme wet）和半雨胎（intermediates）上生成更大的工作范围。我认为这会大大有助于更好地让轮胎进入工作状态，然后甚至能在更大的雨中行驶。”
威廉姆斯车手卡洛斯·塞恩斯也认为倍耐力的整个轮胎系列都需要改进。“我认为雨胎和半雨胎的水平不够好，我们需要与倍耐力合作找到更好的轮胎，因为在混合条件下，半雨胎在后轮仍然是非常弱的轮胎；等它升温时，前轮已经不行了。
“而全雨胎说实话，[在排位赛中]我们出现了大量水滑，后轮抓地力严重不足，所以这两款轮胎仍然缺少一些开发。”
倍耐力面临一项艰巨任务：要为F1 2026年全新规则套件开发雨胎，这些规则包含高扭矩动力单元和主动空气动力学，会给轮胎施加巨大作用力。与此同时，倍耐力还在追逐一个不断变化的目标，即车队究竟能产生多少下压力，而赛季中激烈的研发进展已经超出了这家供应商的预期。
在休赛期，国际汽联在湿地条件下实施了一种部分直道模式以缓解安全担忧，现在只有前翼会被激活。随后在4月，管理机构还降低了湿地条件下的电力输出。据信这两项措施对2026年赛车在湿地中相对安全地比赛的能力产生了很大影响，但它们显然是在倍耐力不得不确定其2026年轮胎系列之后才出台的。
F1首次真正使用全雨胎和半雨胎进行测试来得如此之晚，以至于倍耐力无法将巴西站的教训纳入2027年的考量，因为这家意大利轮胎制造商已经敲定了下赛季的认证。
但在今年早些时候的早期开发工作之后，倍耐力得以在上个月于马尼库尔进行关键的湿地测试，试验其在2026年全年研发的各种解决方案。在这条法国赛道上，梅赛德斯储备车手弗雷德里克·维斯蒂进行了为期两天的测试，其中一天在湿地条件下测试了多种采用不同配方和结构的新型半雨胎。
倍耐力的赛道工程主管西蒙内·贝拉在墨西哥表示：“我们测试了一些方案，尤其是针对半雨胎的方案，最终得到了我们想在下个赛季引入的不错选择。可以肯定的是，我们的想法是改进明年的雨胎产品。”
“我们在配方上做了工作，在胎面厚度上做了工作，也在不同结构上做了工作。所以，我们在轮胎的不同方面做了大量工作，希望把最佳方案结合起来。我们现在正在处理数据，接下来将对新的雨胎配方规格进行认证。”
在圣保罗排位赛后，倍耐力赛车运动负责人达里奥·马拉富斯基坚称，公司已为2027年“取得了一些进展”。他说：“当然，我们非常认真地对待了一些车手的质疑，并在这一年里推进了研发。我们知道总有改进的空间，我们相信我们为明年向前迈出了一些步伐。”
“获得这些信息（来自巴西）非常有价值。遗憾的是，它直到赛季末才出现。我们已经完成了明年的雨胎研发。我不想透露明年雨胎会发生什么，但我们是根据赛季初掌握的信息以及我们在铃鹿进行的一些测试来完成雨胎研发的，所以这对我们来说有助于确定今年的优先事项。”
“我们在马尼库尔进行了一次积极的测试，很快我们就会公布这次湿地测试的结果。”
detailEn: Lando Norris: F1 needs better rain tyres as wet Las Vegas would be "scary"
Leading Formula 1 drivers are hoping Pirelli can make significant improvements to its wet-weather range of tyres

World champion Lando Norris hopes Formula 1 tyre supplier Pirelli will field much-improved rain tyres in 2027 as he expects the current range won't work properly at a low-downforce circuit like Las Vegas.

Following partially rain-affected weekends in Malaysia and Singapore, F1's 2026 cars went through their first proper qualifying and grand prix held in wet conditions at the Brazilian Grand Prix, with both Pirelli's full wet and intermediate compounds being put to the test at Sao Paulo. Qualifying had to be halted for over an hour due to standing water in several corners, with the risk of aquaplaning prompting drivers to run full-wet tyres in Q1 before switching to intermediates.

The race both started and finished on intermediates, with a dry middle spell, dispelling early fears over how the 2026 generation of cars would run in the wet. But while Brazil put on an entertaining spectacle and Pirelli's rain tyres largely worked as expected in the right operating window, drivers still felt this year's stiffer intermediates need work on how they perform in low temperatures as they struggled to keep their cars on the track at the start of a stint and on laps to the grid.

With Interlagos being one of the easiest circuits on the calendar to get tyres into the working range, several drivers voiced concerns that Pirelli's offering won't be robust enough on circuits where that isn't the case, like the upcoming Las Vegas street circuit.

The FIA's official weather forecast is not available yet, but other predictions suggest the chance of rain is over 50% for Free Practice 1 on Thursday evening, with conditions more likely to be dry after that.

With temperatures dipping well below 10C over the Vegas weekend and the circuit lacking any high-speed corners to put lateral load into the tyres, McLaren driver Norris said a wet practice would be quite "scary" because the intermediates don't work when they're too cold.

"When the tyres get cold, it's pretty nasty," Norris said when asked by Motorsport.com for his verdict on F1's first proper wet-weather weekend of this rules cycle. "On laps to the grid, when they get very cold, they felt horrible. If they get into a good window, they're good. So, I think the scary times are if you go to Vegas and you can't get any tyre temperature. You need a much better tyre than what we have here because that's going to be horrible."

Brazil runner-up Max Verstappen added: "I think it's mainly that the working range is a bit too small. When they're hot, it's okay, but when they're cold, they're really like a rock. That's something that we need to try and work on, to generate a bigger working range on the extreme wet [tyres] and the intermediates. I think that would help a lot with switching on the tyre better and then being able to run even in heavier rain."

Williams driver Carlos Sainz also felt Pirelli's entire range needed improvements. "I think the level of the wet and the inter is not good enough and we need to work with Pirelli on finding a better tyre because in the mixed conditions the inter is still a very weak tyre at the rear; by the time it warms up the front is gone.
"And the extreme honestly, [in qualifying] we had so much aquaplaning and a big lack of rear grip, so still missing a bit of development on these two tyres."

Pirelli faced a difficult task developing rain tyres for F1 2026's all-new regulations suite with their high-torque power units and active aerodynamics, putting significant forces through the rubber. It meanwhile chased a moving target of just how much downforce the teams would be able to generate, with fierce in-season development already ahead of the supplier's projections.

Over the off-season the FIA implemented a partial Straight Mode in the wet to ease safety concerns, with only the front wing now being activated. Then, in April, the governing body also reduced electric output in wet conditions. Those two measures are believed to have made a big difference to the 2026 cars' ability to race in the wet relatively safely, but they obviously arrived well after Pirelli had to define its 2026 tyre range.

F1's first proper running on both the extreme wet tyres and intermediates is coming so late in the season that Pirelli can't take Brazil's lessons into account for 2027, as the Italian tyre manufacturer has already finalised its homologations for next season.

But following earlier development work at the start of the year, it was able to conduct crucial wet-weather testing in Magny-Cours last month, trialling the various solutions it worked on over the course of 2026. At the French circuit, Mercedes reserve driver Frederik Vesti conduced two days of testing, including one day in the wet to trial various new intermediate tyres featuring different compounds and constructions.

"We tested some solutions, especially for the intermediates, and we ended up with good options that we would like to introduce for next season," Pirelli's trackside engineering chief Simone Berra said in Mexico. "For sure the idea is to improve the wet-weather product for next year.

"We worked on the compounds, we worked on the tread thickness, we also worked on different structures. So, we worked a lot on different tyre aspects and we would like to combine the best solutions. We are working on the data now and we are going to homologate new wet-weather compound specifications."

Speaking after qualifying in Sao Paulo, Pirelli's head of motorsport Dario Marrafuschi was adamant the company has "made some steps" for 2027. "Of course, we took quite seriously the scepticism from some drivers, and we addressed the development during the year. We know there is always room for improvement and we believe we made some steps ahead for next year," he said.

"It is a great value having this information [from Brazil]. Unfortunately, it is coming only towards the end of the season. We have already closed the wet development for next year. I don't want to disclose what will happen on the wet next year, but we made the wet development based on the information we had at the beginning of the season and some of the testing we did in Suzuka, so that was good for us to address the priorities for this year.
"We had a positive test in Magny-Cours, and quite [soon] we will be disclosing the outcome of this wet test."

detailZh: Toto Wolff预测基米·安东内利将在意大利比迈克尔·舒马赫更受欢迎
梅赛德斯老板Toto Wolff声称意大利F1粉丝比他们喜欢法拉利的迈克尔·舒马赫更喜欢基米·安东内利
Toto Wolff透露：两名赞助商因基米·安东内利离开了梅赛德斯
对于梅赛德斯粉丝来说。来自银箭的最新消息，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析。
梅赛德斯车队负责人Toto Wolff在发表大胆言论方面并不陌生，但对他对基米·安东内利的受欢迎程度的最新评估可能会让忠实的法拉利粉丝感到震惊。
在安东内利在墨西哥城赢得历史性的2026年车手锦标赛胜利后，Wolff接受了德国出版物BILD的独家采访。当对话转向这位20岁天才新星日益增长的星光时，Wolff被问及他的年轻车手是否注定在意大利比七届世界冠军迈克尔·舒马赫更受欢迎。
"绝对是这样！他是意大利人，"Wolff直率地回答。
几十年来，迈克尔·舒马赫在意大利被广泛视为不可触及的神，为斯库德利亚赢得了五个连续的世界冠军。相比之下，安东内利目前为梅赛德斯车队效力，这个车队在历史上被视为法拉利的头号竞争对手。
Wolff 认为，尽管安东内利不是法拉利的车手，但他的意大利血统和真实个性使他超越了团队忠诚。
“是的，但基米凭借他自然的方式和成功所取得的成就，是意大利当然仍然对他的国家队，法拉利——但同时也向这个小意大利敞开了心扉，”Wolff 解释道。
为了证明他的观点，Wolff 直接指出了2026年意大利大奖赛在蒙扎的气氛。根据梅赛德斯老板的说法，传奇的tifosi 主动庆祝了安东内利在他们家乡制造商的成功。
“现在tifosi 穿着法拉利的球衣，戴着梅赛德斯帽子，”Wolff 断言。“蒙扎是完美的例子。观众实际上很伤心，两位红色赛车都没有赢得第一，但他们很高兴，他们的一个基米，站在了领奖台的最顶端。”
安东内利成功锁定2026年冠军，并巩固了自己自1953年阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来首位意大利一级方程式世界冠军的地位，他在国内的受欢迎程度预计只会增长——即使他继续在终点线前击败法拉利。
detailEn: Toto Wolff predicts Kimi Antonelli will become more popular in Italy than Michael Schumacher
Mercedes boss Toto Wolff claims Italian F1 fans love Kimi Antonelli more than they loved Michael Schumacher at Ferrari
Toto Wolff verrät: Zwei Sponsoren verließen Mercedes wegen Kimi Antonelli
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff is no stranger to making bold statements, but his latest assessment of Kimi Antonelli's popularity might actually shock the dedicated Ferrari fanbase.

Following Antonelli's historic 2026 drivers' championship victory in Mexico City, Wolff sat down for an exclusive interview with the German publication BILD. When the conversation shifted to the 20-year-old prodigy's exploding star power, Wolff was asked if his young driver was destined to become more popular in Italy than seven-time world champion Michael Schumacher.
"Absolutely! He is Italian," Wolff bluntly replied.

For decades, Michael Schumacher has been widely considered an untouchable deity in Italy, having secured five consecutive world championships for the Scuderia. In contrast, Antonelli currently races for Mercedes, a team historically viewed as one of Ferrari's primary rivals.
Wolff argued that, although Antonelli is not a Ferrari driver, his Italian heritage and authentic personality have allowed him to transcend team loyalty.

"Yes, but what Kimi has achieved through his natural manner and success is that Italy is, of course, still feverish for his national team, Ferrari - but has also opened its heart and soul to this little Italian," Wolff explained.

To prove his point, Wolff pointed directly to the atmosphere at the 2026 Italian Grand Prix in Monza. According to the Mercedes boss, the legendary Tifosi actively celebrated Antonelli's success over their own hometown constructor.

"The Tifosi are now wearing the Ferrari shirt with a Mercedes cap," Wolff claimed. "Monza was the perfect example. The spectators were actually sad that neither of the two red racers came in first, but they were pleased that Kimi, one of their own, was at the very top of the podium."

With Antonelli successfully locking down the 2026 championship and cementing himself as the first Italian F1 world champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953, his popularity at home is only expected to grow - even if he continues to beat the Ferraris to the finish line.

在激烈的冠军争夺战中，克里斯蒂安·霍纳向托托·沃尔夫发送一条热情的祝贺短信的想法，对于大多数一级方程式车迷来说似乎完全是虚构的。但在基米·安东内利以梅赛德斯车队赢得历史性的2026年冠军之后，这位前红牛车队负责人向他的老对手伸出了赞誉之手。
在接受德国出版物《 Bild》的独家采访时，沃尔夫被问及是否在最近的祝贺声中收到了霍纳的消息。
鉴于霍纳在2025年7月从红牛车队被解雇之前一直是沃尔夫最激烈的对手，采访者质疑奥地利人是否对这一举动感到惊讶。
“是的，但这并没有让我感到惊讶，”沃尔夫表示。“克里斯蒂安和我有着相互尊重的关系。那时就已经是这样了。”
当沃尔夫决定用安东内利替换即将加盟法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿时，批评者们积极质疑这位青少年是否准备好承受一支冠军级车队的巨大压力。在红牛车队任职期间，霍纳曾与类似的青训车队合作，因此他联系沃尔夫，赞扬他敢于冒险。

“恭喜你。基米今年表现得不可思议，我尊重你在如此年轻时就支持他，”霍纳写道。
这次交流揭示了现代涡轮增压混合动力时代两位最强大的车队老板之间罕见的友谊时刻，凸显了他们在赛道上的激烈竞争最终建立在职业尊重的基础之上。

At the height of their bitter championship battles, the idea of Christian Horner sending Toto Wolff a warm congratulatory text would have seemed entirely fictional to most Formula 1 fans. But following Kimi Antonelli's historic 2026 title victory with Mercedes, the former Red Bull team principal reached out to his old adversary with high praise.
In an exclusive interview with the German publication BILD, Wolff was asked if he had heard from Horner amid the flood of recent congratulations.
Given that Horner was Wolff's fiercest rival for years before his dismissal from Red Bull in July 2025, the interviewer questioned if the Austrian was surprised by the gesture.
"Yes, but that didn't surprise me," Wolff stated. "Christian and I have a respectful relationship. That was already the case back then."

When Wolff made the decision to replace Ferrari-bound Lewis Hamilton with Antonelli, critics actively questioned if the teenager was ready for the immense pressure of a championship-calibre team. Having worked with a similar junior driver pipeline during his time at Red Bull, Horner reached out to commend Wolff for taking that gamble.
When asked to reveal the exact contents of the text message, Wolff shared Horner's private words.
"'Congratulations. Kimi was incredible this year and respect for you giving him your back at such a young age,'" Horner wrote.

The exchange reveals a rare moment of camaraderie between the two most dominant team bosses of the modern turbo-hybrid era, underscoring that their intense on-track warfare was ultimately underpinned by professional respect.

麦凯轮赛车首席执行官Zak Brown将2016年加入的团队描述为“一个非常恶劣的环境”，并将多年来的赛道内外不佳成绩归咎于领导层的频繁更迭。
这位美国人十年前加入迈凯轮车队，当时车队股东与罗恩·邓恩分道扬镳，之后他带领车队从车队末尾的排名恢复到2024年和2025年的车队制造商锦标赛。
在接受RACER采访时，布朗表示，当他最初走进车队时，并没有意识到问题的严重性。
“那是一个非常有毒的环境。问题始于领导层的真正不协调以及领导力的缺乏。在六年的时间里，你有了五位不同的老板，”布朗说。
“这在任何商业中都是灾难的配方。如果你在领导层有旋转门，那么团队不知道该跟随谁。这会滋生信任的缺失，并在组织中产生毒性。”
他补充说，对车队的影响是显而易见的。
每个人都处于保护自己、指责他人的模式。这是一个糟糕的环境。这种糟糕的环境体现在糟糕的赛道成绩、缺乏赞助、缺乏粉丝参与和非常不满意的员工队伍。
兰多·诺里斯，麦凯轮，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，麦凯轮，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
布朗承认他最初相信车队自己的解释，即其发动机合作伙伴是主要问题。当沃金团队将本田换成雷诺后，从2017年的车队 constructors' championship 第9位跃升至2018年的第6位，但他表示，这仅仅表明问题有多深。
“我知道在我们当时拥有的1,200人中，我们可能只需要修复其中大约20人。在我心中，毫无疑问，我们有1,100人在那里赢得了许多比赛和冠军。我们需要领导团队的重置，”他说。
在2024年和2025年，麦凯轮车队赢得了车队冠军，兰多·诺里斯在2025年赢得了车手冠军之后，本赛季对布朗领导的车队来说更加艰难。麦凯轮车队在车队积分榜上排名第四，落后红牛17分，尽管诺里斯赢得了三场比赛。
“我们在2024年和2025年赢得了比赛，今年也赢得了比赛，但这并不赋予我们在2027年任何东西。我们必须赢得它，”布朗说。
detailEn: Zak Brown recalls McLaren's "very toxic environment" after joining team in 2016
The McLaren CEO says most of the team's 1,200 staff were not the problem
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.
McLaren Racing CEO Zak Brown has described the team he joined in 2016 as "a very toxic environment", blaming a revolving door of leaders for years of poor results on and off the track.

The American arrived at McLaren a decade ago, after the team's shareholders parted ways with Ron Dennis, and went on to lead its recovery from the back of the grid to the 2024 and 2025 constructors' championships.
Speaking to RACER, Brown said he had not realised the scale of the problems when he first walked in.
"It was a very toxic environment. It started with a real lack of alignment of the leadership as well as a lack of leadership. You had five different bosses in six years," Brown said.

"That's a recipe for disaster in any business. If you have a revolving door at the leadership level, then the team don't know who to follow. That breeds a lack of trust and breeds toxicity inside an organisation."
He added that the effect on the team was clear to see.

"Everyone was in cover-their-ass mode and blame mode. It was a terrible environment. That manifested itself in terrible on-track results, lack of sponsorship, lack of fan engagement and a very unsatisfied workforce."
Lando Norris, McLaren, Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

Brown admitted he had initially believed the team's own explanation that its engine partner was the main problem. When the Woking outfit replaced Honda with Renault, it moved from ninth in the constructors' championship in 2017 to sixth in 2018, but he said that only showed how much deeper the issues ran.

"I knew out of the 1,200 people that we had at the time that we probably only needed to fix about 20 of them. There was no doubt in my mind that we had 1,100 people there who had won a lot of races and championships. It needed the leadership team reset," he said.

After McLaren won the constructors' title in both 2024 and 2025 and Lando Norris secured the drivers' championship in 2025, this season has been tougher for the Brown-led team. McLaren is fourth in the constructors' standings, 17 points behind Red Bull, although Norris has won three races.
"The fact that we won in 2024 and 2025 and that we have won races this year, that doesn't entitle us to anything in 2027. We have got to earn it," Brown said.
